task: Peptide hemolysis from sequence: pHC50 regression (pHC50 = 6 - log10(HC50 in uM), higher = more hemolytic) and P(hemolytic) classification (hemolytic = HC50 < 100 uM, i.e. pHC50 > 4).
architecture: Ensemble of three models on frozen facebook/esm2_t30_150M_UR50D embeddings: a multi-task network (projection, BiLSTM, global MLP, 2-head cross-attention; heads for pHC50 and hemolytic) on per-residue embeddings, an RBF SVR and an RBF SVC on standardised mean-pooled embeddings. pHC50 = mean(SVR, network); P(hemolytic) = mean(SVC, network).

usage.classification: p_hemolytic, for filtering, evaluated at threshold 0.5

embedding: residue embeddings from the shared FeatureExtractor with BOS/EOS stripped, fp32
valid_input: 20 standard uppercase amino acids; training peptides were up to 100 residues, longer inputs are extrapolation

training_data.sources: DBAASP, HemoPI2, Hemolytik; exact 50% hemolysis endpoints only; DBAASP preferred where sources overlap
training_data.weighting: row weight = 1 / cluster_size ** 0.5 (CD-HIT clusters at 80% identity)

validation: 5-fold grouped CV on CD-HIT clusters at 80% identity, zero cross-fold pairs at or above 80% (audited); pooled out-of-fold, single seed, unweighted

metrics_out_of_fold.source: training.ipynb cells 16 and 18, latest run (2026-10-20); report.md predates it and lists different ensembles

known_limits: Out-of-fold Pearson per fold ranged about 0.33 to 0.68 in earlier runs; differences of about 0.02 between models are inside the noise.
Predictions on design candidates compress into a narrow band near the 4.0 threshold: treat pHC50 as a ranking, not calibrated HC50 values.

The 168-peptide metabolic FASTA (GLP-1 / glucagon-like) has no exact overlap with the training data and about 29% best identity (alignment approximation), so predictions for incretin-like peptides are extrapolation.

Exported weights were pickled with scikit-learn 1.9.0; the platform loads them under 1.6.1 (InconsistentVersionWarning). Outputs matched the training project's own Ensemble.predict to about 2e-6 on 68 sequences.
weights_layout: network.pt (config + state_dict), svm_svr.joblib ({'svr', 'svm'} as plain sklearn pipelines), info.json
provenance: Models/Hemolysis prediction/training.ipynb and models.py; ensemble saved to models/regressor/v3_esm2_150M/ensemble_n2293 on 2026-10-20.
supersedes: none: hemolysis_predictor_v1 (random forest) is unchanged and still used by the wound-healing stages; this model is used only by the metabolic Stages 8 and 11. An earlier hemolysis_predictor_v2 (vendored HemoPI2 command-line tool, GPL-3.0, never wired in) was removed and this model took the v2 name.
